svg.title: One instance carries explicit input data from version 1 to version 2
svg.desc: Logical input data flow for the supported standalone .NET continuation path, not a measured execution. BatchLoop keeps the same instance ID across executions E1 at version 1 and E2 at version 2. E1 accepts BatchInputV1 with an immutable SnapshotReference and awaits its existing CountRecordsV1 activity. At the existing final continuation boundary, it requests NewVersion 2 and constructs BatchInputV2 as NewInput with SnapshotReference, the optional CarriedRecordCount, CountContract record-count/v1 and MigrationRequested true. This is explicit serialized data, not old completed history, tasks or CLR state. E2 deserializes its own input shape and applies the application's reuse check: the carried count must be present, nonnegative and use the accepted contract for that same snapshot. A valid zero is reused. Missing, negative or incompatible carried input takes the CountRecordsV2 path; a negative result from that activity fails. Unprocessed external events may also be preserved separately, and their contracts must remain compatible. A compatible backend and an eligible registered version 2 implementation are required.
